posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
I had a game against Deadline a while back while taking the Prime Wardens for a spin where I had Sarabande, Siphon, some Conjurations, Augmented Ally, Destructive Response, Scherzo, and a bunch of Fanatic's ping cards in hand within the first few turns. Deadline often could not keep a single Catastrophe out for longer than two seconds, and on the rare occasion I couldn't entirely handle a Unnatural Disaster I generally could keep it limited to a Severed Ley Line.

Conjured up this amusing mental image of Argent reacting to every attempt Deadline made to cause havoc by just nonchalantly whistling up a tune to undo whatever it was. Bonus mental images of the Prime Wardens standing in the background with "go team!" banners and trash talking cheers.

I feel sorry for Gloomweaver, though. Here he is a big bad demon and avatar of Fear but he's been downgraded to a mere newbie hero training scenario.

I kind of question Voss still being a 3, though. He's tough but not that hugely hard. I feel like he's more of a 2.

On the flipside, I feel like Dreamer should maybe get a 4. She's the one villain I consistently have major trouble defeating. Even Cosmic Omnitron is slightly easier to deal with.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
If I had to make more changes:

Bomber Blade: I agree with bumping down to 2.

Voss: Down to 2, though I agree it may be a little borderline.

Cosmic Omnitron: I feel like I could make a case for it being a 4. I actually find it harder to beat Cosomnitron consistently than I do the Chairman, for instance.

Matriarch: I'm not sure if she's hard so much as she is annoying. Personally the only reason I don't play against her is because she's just beyond annoying in the digital version thanks to all the menus that need clicking through.

The Dreamer: Definitely a 4. It's almost always her flip side that gets me. I usually can muddle through up to that point and then she flips and brings out five zillion more projections and I'm just psychic toast.

Heroic Infinitor: He's kind of an odd case. Before you figure out his "trick" he's hard, but once you do have him figured out he's not too hard to consistently beat. Maybe split the difference as a 2?

Don't have Skin Gloom unlocked yet so I can't weigh in there.
